description: Header file defining the ACodecBufferChannel class, which manages buffer channels for ACodec, including buffer attachment, secure buffer handling, and interaction with media buffers and crypto components.

classes.name: ACodecBufferChannel
classes.description: Manages buffer channels for ACodec, including buffer queuing, secure buffer handling, and interaction with media buffers and crypto components.

methods.name: setCrypto
methods.description: Sets the crypto interface for secure buffer handling.

methods.name: queueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for processing.

methods.name: queueSecureInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues a secure input buffer with encryption parameters.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a C2Buffer to a media buffer.

methods.name: attachEncryptedBuffer
methods.description: Attaches an encrypted buffer with security parameters.

methods.name: renderOutputBuffer
methods.description: Renders an output buffer with a timestamp.

methods.name: pollForRenderedBuffers
methods.description: Polls for buffers that have been rendered.

methods.name: getInputBufferArray
methods.description: Retrieves the array of input buffers.

methods.name: getOutputBufferArray
methods.description: Retrieves the array of output buffers.

methods.name: fillThisBuffer
methods.description: Requests MediaCodec to fill a specific input buffer.

methods.name: drainThisBuffer
methods.description: Requests MediaCodec to drain a specific output buffer.
